answer: Delay sequencing: each identity finishes a one-hour puzzle no parallel machine can shorten. The proof seals a 60-credit ferrous bond in the vault; all enter through one inlet, each proof chained to the last. Fees climb: first 40, the k-th 40+8(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 4,036,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented compute fails: one key ties all proofs, and the vault freezes the cluster. Honest identities pay 40 once at the inlet and reclaim their bonds.
